question: Does the saved KR C2 path (sealed CHAMPION stock weights + residual 069500.KS) keep a positive arithmetic stock-selection term after its market exposure is matched by a tradable ETF + KRW-cash twin whose exposure was knowable at each rebalance?
origin: Proposed by portfolio-edge-forensics-v1 (#309, research/portfolio_edge_forensics_v1/REPORT.md @ 84fe989f) and named the single largest evidence gap by market-industry-alpha-decomposition-v1 (#311 @ e130c64f). This file freezes its contract; it does not reuse #311's full-sample beta 0.63.

fixed.selectionsDatesWeights: UNCHANGED: 155 blocks, 3 names each, weights exactly as docs/results/regional-standalone-paths.json.gz regional.KR[i].weights

definitions.perNameBlockGrowth: G_j = terminalWeight_j * (1 + grossReturn) / w_j from the saved buy-and-hold row; the identity sum_j w_j G_j + cash * riskFreeGrowth = 1 + grossReturn must hold to 1e-7 or the block is SAVED_ROW_IDENTITY_FAILED (never renormalised).
definitions.etfBlockGrowth: Close(endDate) / Close(date) of the pinned Phase C corrected gross ETF total-return series.
definitions.exAnteBeta: Per name, OLS slope of daily KR-session stock returns on corrected-ETF returns over the 252 returns (253 closes) ending at the last KR session <= signalDate; only jointly finite pairs; >= 200 pairs or the name is BETA_UNAVAILABLE and the block is not attributed. Sleeve beta b = weight-average over held names. No shrinkage in the primary; no full-sample beta anywhere.
definitions.control: (e + s*b) in ETF and s*(1-b) in KRW cash; if e + s*b > 1 it is capped at 1 (LEVERAGE_REQUIRED_CAPPED_AT_ETF_100) and if < 0 floored at 0; every clip is counted.
definitions.selection: C2 gross - control gross = s*(R_S - b*R_E - (1-b)*R_F) when unclipped.
definitions.exposure: control gross - ETF gross = s*(b-1)*(R_E-R_F) when unclipped.
definitions.costs: weekly_decision.trade_cost_fraction('KR', date, side, is_benchmark): commission + half-spread per leg, dated sell tax for stocks, ETF sell tax for the 069500.KS leg; charged on the drifted prior book exactly as the replay's account() does; the control's cash leg is free; multipliers 1x/2x/3x on both C2 and control.; the ETF-only alternative (the replay's P0) pays its single initial 100% buy at the same schedule and nothing after (R3)
definitions.turnover: one-way, split into names REPLACED and weights RETARGETED (AGENTS.md v2.11).
definitions.horizons: H126 = every run of 6 consecutive 21-session blocks, H252 = 12; overlapping windows are descriptive; non-overlapping counts are 25 (H126) and 12 (H252).
definitions.compounding: annual log-growth gap = arithmetic active + Jensen term (exact identity, as #309).
definitions.drawdown: MDD on block-end net NAV (daily MDD is not reconstructed by this study).
definitions.reconstruction: before anything is attributed, the C2 net path (stocks + ETF residual, costs as the replay's account()) and the ETF-only path are compared with docs/weekly-decision/weekly-passive-first-v1-replay-corrected-benchmark.json regions.KR.paths.{C2,P0}.{cagrPct,cumulativeNetReturnPct}; CAGR uses replay_valuation.span_years (days / 365.2425)
definitions.descriptiveOutputs: exact per-block reconciliation net C2 - net ETF = SELECTION + EXPOSURE + COST (COST = exact residual) annualised, plus Jensen; net-of-cost selection interval; turnover REPLACED/RETARGETED; clip count and dates; BETA_UNAVAILABLE dates; C2-minus-control over every H126/H252 run and the non-overlapping runs; a fixed recent slice from 2024-01-01. None of these is a verdict input except as stated in decisionRule.

cashScenarios.INVESTABLE_KRW_CASH: SOURCE_BLOCKED: no pinned investable KRW cash/deposit/MMF/CD91/KOFR full-span series exists in this repository; never substituted
cashScenarios.rule: a verdict needs all three to agree; the band brackets, it does not measure, an investable cash return

inference.series: per-block SELECTION, annualised by blocks per year
inference.estimator: mean with Bartlett Newey-West SE, lag 5 (126 sessions); 95% normal interval
inference.multiplicity: one primary statistic, three cash scenarios required to agree (conjunction, no correction needed for a PASS); no other test is confirmatory
inference.independence: one historical KR sample already exposed to outcomes; at most 25 non-overlapping H126 windows

decisionRule.SELECTION_SURVIVES_FIXED_EXPOSURE: all three cash scenarios: 95% lower bound > 0 at cost 1x AND the 95% lower bound of the NET-of-cost (1x) per-block C2-minus-control series > 0 (R2) AND net C2-minus-control arithmetic active > 0 at cost 2x
decisionRule.SOURCE_OR_SAMPLE_INSUFFICIENT: any scenario without an interval, or > 10% of blocks unattributable, or the reconstructed C2 / ETF (P0) net path does not reproduce the replay's published KR C2 and P0 cagrPct and cumulativeNetReturnPct within 0.0005pp (R1)
decisionRule.consequence: No outcome promotes C2 or changes the production ETF default. SURVIVES keeps C2 as a research control worth a prospective test; NO_EVIDENCE/NEGATIVE records that C2's saved CAGR lead is not stock selection after matched exposure.

knownLimitations: stock returns are as-traded close with forward-accumulated Yahoo distributions only where served; 5 held names carry zero dividend events (000030, 000060, 002550, 047040, 207940; evidence/c2-price-coverage.json), 3 of them later terminated but every holding ended 1.5+ years before delisting, so no terminal consideration is needed

the corrected ETF series starts 2012-01-02: only 251 quotes precede the first anchor, so the earliest beta windows have <= 250 ETF returns (above the 200-pair floor; counted, not filled from the replay-v16 series, which double-applies distributions, nor from a price-only Yahoo series)
the ETF leg is the Phase C reconciled gross total return (before investor tax); its external accrual anomaly (AGENTS v2.46/v2.47) is carried, not repaired
industry allocation vs selection (Brinson) is NOT computable: no official KODEX200 constituent/sector weight history is in the repository
realised fills do not exist: C2 is a target-weight replay, so execution slippage beyond the dated cost schedule is not measured
independentAuditCriteria: re-derive G_j from three saved rows by hand and confirm the buy-and-hold identity
confirm no index after signalDate is read in the beta window (window_closes uses bisect_right on the signal date)
confirm selection + exposure == C2 - ETF on every attributed block (asserted in code)
confirm costs match replay account() on a block where control == C2 (all-ETF)
confirm verdict thresholds are read from this file's decisionRule and not changed after execution
executionPlan: Owner commits research/alpha_evidence_sprint_v2/AUTHORIZATION-c2.json (content in C2-APPROVAL-PACKET.md) with phrase 'APPROVE KR_PHASE_D_EXCEPTION c2-fixed-exposure-attribution-v1 <sha256 of this file>' and the sha256 of c2_attribution.py and c2_attribution_run.py; then `python research/alpha_evidence_sprint_v2/c2_attribution_run.py execute <replay-v16 ledger dir>` runs once and writes only research/alpha_evidence_sprint_v2/c2-fixed-exposure-attribution-v1-result.json. Any later code or spec change voids the authorization. Outcome-free check available at any time: `... preflight <ledger dir> --out <file>`.

SURVIVES additionally needs the net-of-cost 1x C2-minus-control Newey-West 95% lower bound > 0 (the registered SELECTION series is gross of cost by construction); NEGATIVE branch unchanged

engine defects fixed before any execution (author audit, AUTHOR_VALIDATION_ONLY): (a) execute called replay_valuation.normalize_daily_series, which does not exist (would have crashed after approval) -> pipeline.market_dates.normalize_daily_series; (b) the >10% unattributable rule was never enforced in verdict(); (c) a BETA_UNAVAILABLE block also erased the C2 and ETF paths, which need no beta -> only the control path breaks, never restarted; (d) the ETF-only path paid no initial buy while P0 and C2 do; (e) turnover REPLACED/RETARGETED was defined but never reported; (f) authorization only checked that a file existed -> must be committed, unmodified, and every commit touching it authored by the owner's identity, not an agent's; (g) nothing enforced one execution -> refuses when the canonical result exists on disk or in git history; (h) years were days/365.25 vs the replay's 365.2425
